description: People get thirsty and drink from springs they remember; with no spring known, they go looking.

Spring.description: A spring of drinking water. It never runs dry. Noah must be asked to place springs (--place Spring=N); they are not tied to lakes (see notes).

water.description: 1 while it gives water. Never lowered by this pack; kept so a later pack can dry springs up.

Thirst.description: The need to drink. Rises steadily; drinking lowers it.

Quench.description: Drink before thirst becomes dangerous. Barely matters below a quarter thirst, then grows fast.

Drink.description: Walk to a remembered spring that still has water and drink.

SeekWater.description: Thirsty with no known water: head into the unknown to find some.
